messages:
lina-cs: FYI got a vendor security questionnaire from AcmeBank — they attached a Vendor Risk Form + request for our SOC2 and signed DPA. Deadline Fri EOD. any objections to sharing SOC2 redacted?

sam-legal: Can you post the vendor name + their intake form? Need to check scoping for DPA and whether we need exec review.

lina-cs: Uploaded the form to drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/acmebank/vendor-intake.pdf

kevin-sec: We can share SOC2 Type II 2024 but must redact client names. I'll prep a redacted copy. Also need to confirm if they require encryption-at-rest evidence and key management details.

marta-onboard: Heads-up — AcmeBank is in onboarding, renewal could be at risk if security gating stalls. Prioritize please.

sam-legal: I'll review their DPA requests. If they ask detailed control responses, we'll send the standard Vendor Self-Assessment (VSRA) and offer a short controls summary.

kevin-sec: Quick checklist:
```
- Upload redacted SOC2 report
- Provide encryption-at-rest statement & KMS info
- Confirm data residency: EU
- Complete VSRA questionnaire
```

lina-cs: Assigning to @sam-legal and @kevin-sec. I'll keep AM and onboarding lead in the loop.

devops-bot: New evidence folder created: /evidence/acmebank-1746001234

marta-onboard: ETA for SOC2 redaction?

kevin-sec: EOD Thu for redaction, will upload and tag as shared when ready.

lina-cs: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and mark renewal risk as 'monitoring' until cleared.
